analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: S&P 500 stays under resistance at 7240. The desk targets 7120, then the 50% retracement at 7080. A break above 7240 would target 7315, then the 200-day moving average at 7350.
DAX trades below 25,625 resistance with a downside target of 25,300, then 25,140. A break above 25,625 would target 25,785, then 26,165.
EuroStoxx50 is capped by 6150 resistance with downside targets of 6080 and 6020. A break above 6150 would target 6180, then 6200.
SMI is capped by 14,780 resistance with downside targets of 14,655 and 14,605. A break above 14,780 would target 14,860, then 14,960.
The desk's 2-5 day trend is down for the S&P 500, DAX and EuroStoxx50, and neutral for the SMI. The intraday trend is down for all four indices.
